In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ATM-UBR service model is suitable for satellite-ATM networks, but the performance is dependent on the buffer size at the switches, and the nature of the traffic.
the ATM-UBR service model is sufficient to support the transport of TCP/IP traffic over satellite ATM networks.
a satellite ATM network can be designed to provide the required performance for Internet traffic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the satellite ATM technology is a viable technology for providing Internet services.
a satellite-ATM network can effectively transport the Internet traffic with a buffer size of 0.5 to 1 RTT.
the buffer requirement for TCP/IP over ATM-UB is small and the fairness of TCP traffic is good over satellite ATM networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ATM service model is important for satellite ATM networks and a careful design of the network is required to provide high performance.
a buffer size of 0.5 to 1 * round-trip time (RTT) is sufficient to support TCP traffic over ATM-ubr for satellite ATM networks.
a satellite ATM network can be designed with the ATM service model and traffic management policies to provide good performance to Internet traffic.
